# Reuse review, round 1

## 1. `isSame` duplicates `samePosition` (should fix)

`app/apps/web/src/features/classroom/TeacherSlides.tsx:18` defines
`const isSame = (a: Position, b: Position) => a.slide === b.slide && a.step === b.step;`.
`@kurasu/slides/navigation` already exports the identical `samePosition`
(`app/packages/slides/src/navigation.ts:25`), and `StudentSlides.tsx:3` imports it from there
(`@kurasu/slides` is already a web dependency). Delete `isSame` and import `samePosition`.

## 2. `useQuestionsByVotes` options type repeats `useFeaturedSession`'s pattern (minor, no action)

The `Omit<QueryOptions<..., E>, "select">` signature added in
`app/apps/web/src/features/questions/useQuestionsByVotes.ts` follows the same shape as
`useFeaturedSession.ts`. It reuses `QueryOptions`/`EndpointError`, so it is consistent with the
codebase. It does not need a shared helper for two uses.

## 3. TeacherSlides sets and cancels cache by hand instead of using `useApiMutation` options (minor, judgment call)

`TeacherSlides.tsx` calls `cancelQueries` + `setQueryData` directly. `useApiMutation` already has
`optimistic` (cancel/snapshot/apply) and an `onSuccess` hook for `setQueryData`, which
`useMoveSlide` used before this change. The new flow deliberately cannot use them because it
saves only the last position per save cycle and applies the cache only once at the end, so a
local implementation is justified. Other `setQueryData` calls (`useOpenSession.ts:15`,
`useUpdateProfile.ts:16`) are plain `onSuccess` writes, so there is no existing helper for the
"cancel then set" pair to reuse.

## 4. Skeleton-with-examples in the home route (no issue)

`routes/_app/index.tsx` reuses the existing `pollExamples`, `questionExamples`,
`sessionExamples` and `SkeletonOf`; removing `FeaturedQuestions` leaves no orphan example or
wrapper. `FeaturedQuestionsCard` and `useQuestionsByVotes` are reused as-is.

Count: 1 actionable finding (#1); 3 notes with no action required.
EOF
